pages.title: Among the trees
pages.text: The forest hides more than it seems.

pages.title: What is here
pages.text: $(li)$(l:forest/mavka_tree)Mavka Trees$(/l) and $(l:forest/titan_tree)Titan Trees$(/l);$(li)$(l:forest/roots)Roots$(/l) that point toward a Titan Tree;$(li)the $(l:forest/mavka_flower)Mavka Flower$(/l) atop a Titan Tree;$(li)creatures: $(l:forest/mavka)Mavka$(/l), $(l:forest/chugaister)Chuhaister$(/l), $(l:forest/hukha)Hukha$(/l), $(l:forest/zlyden)Zlydeny$(/l), $(l:forest/bisyk)Bisyk$(/l), $(l:forest/skarbnyk)Skarbnyk$(/l).$(br2)If you see a huge tree, do not rush past. It may lead you to something interesting. Or to someone who dislikes guests.
